mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) outpace supply growth (INDPRO), it indicates overheating demand that drives short-term equity price increases over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns in 5 days when GDPC1 exceeds INDPRO, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) creates dual easing conditions, fostering long-term equity appreciation over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns over 60 days when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE are below their 12-month averages, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in unemployment (UNRATE) below 6.5% signals a strengthening labor market, prompting equity price increases over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when UNRATE crosses below 6.5%, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) declines below personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1), it signals favorable conditions for equity growth in the short term over 5 days.
failure_condition: No positive returns in 5 days when FEDFUNDS is below GDPC1, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in supply (INDPRO) alongside monetary easing (FEDFUNDS decline) amplifies inflationary pressures, driving equity price increases over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS < INDPRO, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, further declines in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) intensify equity valuation appreciation over 60 trading days due to reduced discount rates.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns in late-cycle periods despite FEDFUNDS declines, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Elevated labor participation (PAYEMS) above 60.0 indicates a robust job market, driving short-term equity gains over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: No positive returns in 5 days when PAYEMS exceeds 60.0, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
